name: wejhaty-travel-worker
description: Cloudflare Worker backend for Wejhaty's travel API and (Phase 16) AI intelligence layer. Structurally separate from app/ (the GitHub Pages frontend) — not bundled into it, not deployed by deploy-pages.yml. wrangler is now a devDependency (Phase 16 needs it to validate the [ai] binding config), but this Worker is still NOT deployed by any automated step in this repository — see ../SECRETS.md.

scripts.deploy: echo 'Not run automatically — see ../README.md and ../SECRETS.md. Requires wrangler login or CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN (deployment auth — NOT an AI credential) before ever running: npx wrangler deploy'
